findings.title: D-055 in docs/delivery/decisions.md (a candidate file) still says that reaching crypto.setEngine 'by namespace enumeration is residual (a), F-DG1-132/215'. Since rule 5 (F-DG1-132/133), the lint flags that route at the import, and the testkit header says it is CLOSED. The decision record contradicts the lint it documents.
findings.reproduction: Candidate sha256:619d74ff…dfac (freeze 987ae02). `git show 987ae02:docs/delivery/decisions.md | sed -n 7p | grep -o 'now banned by rule 1 (every spelled form; reaching it by namespace enumeration is residual (a), F-DG1-132/215)'` returns the sentence. Compare apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts:21-22 and :61-63 at the same commit ('the enumeration route is closed by rule 5'; 'is CLOSED by rule 5'). The r11->r12 manifest diff shows that decisions.md was not changed by the fix. The search for stale wording in the candidate (19-f133-wording-check.log, plus `git grep 'residual (a)|namespace enumeration' 987ae02`) finds this one sentence and no others outside metadata.
findings.expected: The D-055 text (or a new decision entry that supersedes it) records that the node:crypto namespace-enumeration route is closed by rule 5, named imports only (F-DG1-132/133). It no longer calls the route residual (a).
findings.actual: D-055 still describes the round-11 state, with enumeration as the accepted residual (a). The code and tests are correct, and only this decision record is stale. It is a documentation-accuracy defect in a delivery record with no runtime or security effect, so it is Low and non-mandatory and does not block DG1.

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG1 round 12 while verifying F-DG1-132/133. F-DG1-133's scope (the testkit header and the E-case comment) is fixed and verified. This is the one remaining stale statement, in D-055. Proposed ID: the next free number in the qa 2xx range (F-DG1-216); the orchestrator may renumber. Low and non-mandatory. I would accept it as an observation if the auditor agrees, or it can be fixed by a one-line D-055 correction.
